title: Raw 3270 attribute bytes in a BMS symbolic map: names vs literals, non-graphic bytes, bit arithmetic, left-over input flags

scenarios.summary: the first screen: every attribute byte as BMS sends it, including which ones BMS ignores
ENTER after typing a name and ERASE-EOF on LEFTOVR: the fields whose MDT the program turned on come back untouched, and DATAONLY sends only fields with data or a real attribute

steps.note: SECRET (X'4D'), BLINKY (X'F1'), TWIDDLE (X'41') and FSETF (map FSET) have the MDT bit on and are transmitted although untouched; RAW (X'3C') has it off; LEFTOVR was cleared with ERASE EOF

scenarios.summary: CLEAR on the second task: the map is resent with MAPONLY, every attribute and data value from the map
PA1 on the second task: it is not CLEAR, so the program issues RECEIVE MAP; a PA key transmits no data, so MAPFAIL (not a transmission of the MDT-on fields), and DATAONLY sends only STAT
